children: On October 9, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days (Aug 26–Oct 8), violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The notice has no immediate effect; the company has until April 7, 2027 to regain compliance (10 consecutive trading days at or above $1.00) and may obtain an additional 180 days by transferring to the Nasdaq Capital Market if it meets applicable criteria.
